text:
anna_support: FYI ticket #54321 — customer sees tool invoke rejected with 422 schema error. They say it worked yesterday. payload + repro below.

mike_custsuccess: Customer: Acme Corp. Reported impact: production webhook failing, ~5% of requests hitting the tool path. Getting back `422: invalid_request` from gateway.

anna_support: Paste of payload they send (sanitized):
```json
{
  "customer_id": 98765,
  "action": "invoice:create",
  "items": [
    { "sku": "X100", "qty": 3, "unit_price": "19.99" }
  ],
  "meta": { "source": "integrations", "debug": true },
  "extra_flag": false
}
```

enggie: Looks like two issues from quick glance: 1) schema expects customer_id as string, not number (type mismatch). 2) function schema has `additionalProperties: false` so `extra_flag` will reject. Also unit_price should be numeric not string. Repro steps?

anna_support: Repro steps from customer: 1) POST /v1/tools/invoke with body above 2) header Authorization: Bearer <token> 3) they use region us-west2 4) error immediate, no latency.

runtime-bot: deploy-bot: No recent schema changes in prod for the invoicing tool (last change 1749900000). No canary flags active.

mike_custsuccess: They said it was working ~48h ago. They upgraded their SDK yesterday — possibly started stringifying amounts.

enggie: Can you repro locally? If SDK sent unit_price as string the validator will fail. Also `additionalProperties: false` in our jsonschema means any stray top-level keys (extra_flag) break the call. I can add a compatibility shim but we should confirm which behavior product wants.

paul_pm: Product follow-up: We allowed extra properties historically but tightened validation last sprint to prevent downstream charge noise. If partners accidentally rely on lax schema we need a planned compatibility path.

anna_support: Customer wants a hotfix — either accept unit_price as string or strip extra unknown keys. They are blocked in prod.

enggie: Short-term plan: 1) Add a lenient parser in the gateway that coerces numeric strings for unit_price and coerces customer_id numbers to string when possible. 2) Log and emit a metric for any additionalProperties rejections so we can track adoption. 3) Mid-term: doc & SDK patch to prevent serialization bugs.

natalie_billing: FYI billing team: if we allow string amounts we must ensure rounding & currency parsing unchanged. Might need a validation step before passing to billing ledger.

mike_custsuccess: Customer is okay with a temporary shim as long as we guarantee no silent misbilling.

enggie: I'll open an urgent PR to the gateway shim (tag: support/1749998888-shim). Will run canary in us-west2 only. Can ops monitor errors for that tenant specifically?

runtime-bot: ops: Please create a temporary alert for 'toolcall.schema.additionalProps' spike for tenant=98765 and a low-latency trace sample.

anna_support: I'm adding the customer to the ticket and asking for exact SDK version.

paul_pm: Make sure we include a rollback plan and a changelog note — we shouldn't silently relax validation forever.

enggie: Will follow up with PR link + canary URL in thread when ready. :thumbsup:

anna_support: Thanks — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the escalation.
